name: 501 (Russian card game)
description: 501 is a Russian three-player card game: hybrid of 1000 (dealing, bidding) and 66 (marriage scores, fixed trump). 24-card pack; A,10,K,Q,J,9. Marriages in trump 40, non-trump 20. Bid to 501; clockwise deal and play.

overview.description: 501 is a Russian three-player card game: hybrid of 1000 (dealing, bidding) and 66 (marriage scores, fixed trump). 24-card pack; A,10,K,Q,J,9. Marriages in trump 40, non-trump 20. Bid to 501; clockwise deal and play.

history.origins: Russia; hybrid of 1000 (dealing, bidding) and 66 (marriage scores, fixed trump). Described by Michael Latash from Moscow; possibly an intermediate between older 66 and newer 1000.
timeline: 501 as hybrid with marriages and bid to 501
Documented by John McLeod based on rules described by Michael Latash.

setup.players: 3 active (or 4 with dealer sitting out). Deal and play clockwise.
setup.deck: 24-card pack: A, 10, K, Q, J, 9 per suit. Marriages: trump 40, non-trump 20. 120 points in pack.
setup.dealing: Deal and bid clockwise; bid to 501; fixed trump by turn of card or similar.

rules.objective: Be the first player to reach 501 points. Points from tricks (card values) plus marriages (trump 40, non-trump 20).
rules.gameplay: Deal 24-card pack; bid to 501; trump fixed. Play tricks; follow suit when possible. Count trick points and declare marriages (K+Q of same suit).

strategy.basic: Count trumps and key cards; follow suit when possible.
strategy.advanced: Bid to your strength; manage risk to 501.
tips: Reach 501 points to win; trick values and contract matter.

scoring.description: Card values in tricks; marriage in trump 40, in non-trump 20. First to 501 wins.
scoring.winCondition: Be the first player to reach 501 points. Points from tricks (card values) plus marriages (trump 40, non-trump 20).
